LeadProsperAPITokenCredential.title: Lead Prosper API Token
LeadProsperAPITokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: In Lead Prosper, open Settings → API and copy an account API token. Paste only the token. NoClick sends it as a Bearer header to api.leadprosper.io. Campaign reads verify access; write permissions depend on the token owner's role.

view.description:
How much of each campaign to return: a preset of `select`. Not with `select`.

| `view` | Returns |
|---|---|
| `short` | `id`, `name`, `public_name`, `campaign_type`, `setup_complete`. For finding a campaign by name. |
| `basic` (default) | `short`, plus `distribution` and `fields`; each supplier's `id`, `name`, `position`, `client`, `paused`, `test_mode`, `api_specs_url` and `pricing_summary`; each buyer's `id`, `name`, `position`, `client`, `paused`, `delivery.type`, `weight`, `weight_share`, `buyer_group_id` and `pricing_summary`. |
| `full` | everything: also `settings`, each supplier's and buyer's `pricing` in the shape the update takes, a supplier's `bidding`, and a buyer's whole `delivery`. |
view.title: View

buyers.description: Which buyers to include: `active` (the default) leaves out paused buyers, `all` includes them.
buyers.title: Buyers

setup.description: Which campaigns to list, by `setup_complete`: `complete`, those with at least one supplier and one buyer; `incomplete`, those still missing one; `all`, both. Defaults to `complete`.

buyers.description: Which buyers to include. `active`, the default, leaves out buyers that are paused, because a paused buyer is not receiving leads; `all` includes them. ScheduleConfig.description:
Schedule configuration from the frontend widget.
Fields accept Union[int, str] to support drag-and-drop references like
{{nodeId.values.field}} which get resolved at configuration time.

daysOfWeek.description: Days of week to run on (0=Sunday … 6=Saturday); empty = every day. Supported for seconds/minutes/hours intervals and daily schedules.
daysOfWeek.title: Daysofweek

windowStart.description: Part-of-day start as 24-hour "HH:MM" in the schedule timezone (e.g. "09:00"). Set together with windowEnd; interval frequencies only.
windowStart.title: Windowstart

windowEnd.description: Part-of-day end as 24-hour "HH:MM", inclusive — a run landing exactly on it fires (e.g. "18:00" runs the 6:00 PM tick).
windowEnd.title: Windowend

monthDayStart.description: Part-of-month start day (1-31), inclusive. Set together with monthDayEnd; a start after the end wraps around month end (25→5 = the 25th through the 5th).
monthDayStart.title: Monthdaystart

monthStart.description: Part-of-year start month (1=January … 12=December), inclusive. Set together with monthEnd; a start after the end wraps around the new year (11→2 = November through February).
monthStart.title: Monthstart

ScheduleConfig.title: ScheduleConfig
